data.title: Mounting pressure on Iran could lead to attack on Israel despite US peace talks | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: "The consequences of a US agreement with Iran are very severe even if they do not have an effect on Israel’s freedom of action," former national security council head Meir Ben-Shabbat explained.
